# F1: Fit and finish, home-watching

A check of the Watching module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/1-home-watching.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

fit and finish, home-watching (per-area reports, 4 Nov). [Home] n and [WA] n are the findings of the Home report and the Watching and Activity report.
